item.title: Real life
item.description:
I decide to create this blog to share real life experices of a software engineer in a world where it seems there is no more reality, where everyone seems perfect, super efficient with no flaws building rocket-science projects.

However, the truth is far from that and software engineering is more like an empty canvas where engineers work as artists, painting the next portrait filed with uncertaints but doing their best to make the least wrong decisions…

item.title: About me
item.description:
Hey there, Cris here!

I am a software engineer that loves learning and sharing knowladge and expiriences. My entire carrer has been around Python 🐍 and its frameworks as well as the countless additional tools a software engineer must handle.

Building scale applications applying software architecture and system design are what I like the most in software engineering industry. My technical journey is rooted in a deep love for architecture, code quality, and the challenge of making complex systems work seamlessly.
